model: Ideal DC resistor network only. Not SPICE, no op-amp macro-model, no switching converter transient simulation. Monte Carlo assumes independent uniform resistor errors +/-0.1%.
rail_endpoint_warning: Nominal -5/+5 V maps to supply rails: real output swing and loading reduce usable endpoint range. Calibrate/limit firmware range.
input_power_formula: I_RACK = (Vout * Iout)/(VIN * converter_efficiency) + housekeeping; unknown actual FPGA load and efficiency
